decisions.reason: The embedded Skill-title lock for 光明 is firing inside ordinary prose 光明的未来, where the current phrase means a bright future; this needs a scoped canonical matcher fix rather than a one-off replacement.

canonical_finding.concept: Generic adjective 光明 versus named Skill title
canonical_finding.reason: Skill-title matching fires inside ordinary prose 光明的未来 and would incorrectly force the Skill name Ánh sáng.

decisions.proposed_text: Sáng thì buồn ngủ, bữa trưa thì ngon, tối thì mệt. Chẳng có gì cả.\nNhưng đôi khi cũng có thể mong chờ một chút chứ. Dù sao mình cũng là Mã Nương mà.
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use the project world/species term Mã Nương rather than forbidden Uma Musume; the rest of the meaning and newline structure are preserved.

decisions.proposed_text: Giờ đây, bản giao hưởng tựa dải ngân hà xa xôi vang vọng.\nĐể giành lại ánh sao trong bóng tối, hãy lao đi như sao chổi — “Mã Nương vũ trụ”.
decisions.reason: Generic 赛马娘 must use Mã Nương; the cosmic modifier and all imagery are otherwise preserved.
Character alias 放声欢呼 is matching an ordinary imperative phrase meaning to cheer loudly; replacing it with Gran Alegria here would corrupt the sentence, so the alias needs scoped canonical hardening.

canonical_finding.concept: Generic cheer-loudly phrase versus Gran Alegria character alias
canonical_finding.reason: The character alias fires inside ordinary prose 来吧，放声欢呼吧 where it is clearly a verb phrase, not a character mention.

decisions.proposed_text: Ký ức ngày ấy bồng bềnh như hơi nước, khó quên mà lại mơ hồ…\nXin mời lắng nghe “Yukoma Roman Junjoha”.
decisions.reason: The named theme song must use its established romanized proper name instead of the current Vietnamese semantic calque.
